name: app-tractoflow
summary: Runs the TractoFlow Nextflow pipeline (scilus 1.6.0 container) on a DWI and T1w image to produce preprocessed DWI, a resampled T1 and a particle-filtering (PFT) tractogram.
description: Arranges the inputs as a single-subject TractoFlow input folder, installs Miniconda and Nextflow 21.10.6 at run time, clones the scilus/tractoflow repository and runs it with the scilus 1.6.0 Singularity image. TractoFlow performs DWI preprocessing (denoising, eddy/topup, registration, resampling), tensor and fODF fitting and PFT tracking. It needs internet access on the compute node and about four hours on 16 cores.

inputs.description: Raw DWI (NIfTI) with bvals and bvecs.
ACPC-aligned T1-weighted image of the same subject.

outputs.description: Preprocessed, resampled DWI from TractoFlow with the bvals/bvecs of the fODF shell.
Probabilistic particle-filtering tractogram seeded in white matter (.trk).
